name: type
meaning: Kind of digital object being described.
defaultFormat: IRI to a type such as dataset, software application, or image

name: identifier
meaning: Globally unique, persistent, machine-resolvable identifier for the object.

name: name
meaning: Descriptive title of the digital object.

name: description
meaning: Human-readable summary of what the object is and why it exists.

name: dateCreated
meaning: Date the object was created or added to a repository.

name: author
meaning: Person or organization responsible for creating the object.

name: measurementTechnique
meaning: Technique or technology used in measurement, when applicable.

name: distribution
meaning: Link to a downloadable copy (bitstream or file).

name: citation
meaning: Reference to another creative work related to this object.

name: infectiousAgent
meaning: Infectious agent involved in the study or object.

name: conditionsOfAccess
meaning: Conditions under which the object can be accessed (open, registered, controlled, and so on).

name: license
meaning: License under which the object is distributed.
defaultFormat: SPDX License Identifier, or IRI to a license document

name: spatialCoverage
meaning: Geographic area covered by the object.

name: temporalCoverage
meaning: Time period covered by the object.
